channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: US-Iran conflict flares again as Tehran launches missiles and drones after fresh US strikes
item.description: Iran’s Tasnim news agency reported that Iranian forces had launched a “decisive operation” against US bases across the region. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said the latest fighting had “only tightened the lock on the Strait of Hormuz,” according to state broadcaster IRIB.

item.title: Trump's USPS mail-ballot system: Whistleblower warns of errors ahead of 2026 midterms
item.description: According to the whistleblower’s claims cited by Blumenthal, USPS is preparing a system with what the senator described as an “impracticable zero percent failure rate.”

item.title: Trump says US strikes on Iran are ‘very justified’, warns ‘biggest attack of them all waiting'
item.description: Iran’s Armed Forces General Staff and joint military command vowed retaliation, saying the country’s armed forces would deliver “crushing and devastating blows” against the United States.

item.title: ‘Hitting rock bottom’: 7 hungry days gave this startup founder the courage to fail; LinkedIn reacts
item.description: Abhishek Agarwal reflects on his experience of being broke at 18, stating it taught him resilience and strength. He believes everyone should experience hitting rock bottom.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial: Jurors fail to reach unanimous verdict; What happens with a hung jury?
item.description: The judge acknowledged the length of the trial but directed jurors to return to the deliberation room and continue considering the case.

item.title: Corporate compliance relief scheme’s validity extended up to 15 September
item.description: The latest extension follows representations received from various stakeholders, the corporate affairs ministry said

item.title: ‘Something to lose’: Bengaluru man explains why ₹2 lakh salary makes career risks harder
item.description: Shashank Dixit said reaching this salary can create a sense that life and career are going well enough. The income, according to him, can reassure parents, support a comfortable lifestyle and allow people to enjoy their weekends without having to worry excessively about money.

item.title: Haryana: Why buffalo milk may hit ₹100/litre as dairy farmers back hike; ₹21,000 fine for selling below fixed rates
item.description: Buffalo milk prices in Haryana districts may rise to ₹100 per litre as farmers seek higher rates due to increased cattle feed, fodder, and transport costs. Current prices range from ₹60 to ₹80 per litre, prompting dairy farmers to hold meetings to address the issue.

item.title: US launches strikes on Iran’s IRGC targets after attacks on commercial vessels in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US military said the strikes followed “recent attempted attacks by the IRGC against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and against American service members deployed to the region.”

item.title: Centre raises windfall tax on petrol, diesel exports, cuts levy on jet fuel
item.description: On Tuesday, India raised windfall taxes on petrol and diesel exports, while decreasing the jet fuel tax. Current export duties reflect the volatility in crude oil prices, with government estimates of significant revenue collection from these levies.

item.title: Times Square stabbing victim identified as Bank of America vice president Erin Piacenti
item.description: Erin Piacenti, a vice president of business selection and conflicts at Bank of America, died in hospital from injuries sustained in the stabbing.

item.title: Govt shifts raw sugar import quota to daily allocation amid rising prices
item.description: The government also halves the stockholding limit for sugar dealers to 2,000 quintals from 4,000 quintals, effective 15 September through 30 November, tightening curbs on hoarding and speculative trading.

item.title: New LPG gas cylinder rules: Price hike, e-KYC and potential connection ban, what to know about Indane, HP, Bharat Gas
item.description: New LPG gas cylinder rules: Multiple changes took effect in LPG cylinder distribution on Tuesday, 1 September, including a price hike for commercial LPG cylinders.&nbsp;

item.title: ITR filings cross 78 million for AY27, setting new record
item.description: The milestone comes against a backdrop of sustained growth in ITR filings.

item.title: ‘Stop pinching pennies’: Personal finance advice on saving vs investing sparks social media debate
item.description: Yashna Bhuwania challenges the notion that saving alone leads to wealth. She argues that savings can finance investments, making both strategies complementary rather than opposing.

item.title: India eyes plastic notes: How govt plans to keep polymer currency secure from China, Pakistan influence
item.description: Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Private Limited, the currency-printing subsidiary of the RBI, has shared a global Expression of Interest inviting domestic and foreign manufacturers to supply opacified polymer substrate sheets. Here's what it means.

item.title: ‘I literally have PTSD’: Woman recalls ‘toxic’ Indian office culture after moving back from US
item.description: Khyati stated that she and her husband moved back to India four years ago. She said returning helped them avoid visa-related issues and gave them greater freedom to explore ideas such as starting a business or taking a break from work.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Bessent says Strait of Hormuz could become ‘worthless’ in two years
item.description: Bessent's comments came amid renewed tensions between the United States and Iran, with the two sides exchanging strikes on Monday.

item.title: Windfall tax revised from September 1: Petrol export duty up from 0 to ₹1.5/litre, diesel ₹1; ATF levy cut ₹0.5
item.description: The government has raised the windfall tax on petrol and diesel exports while reducing the levy on aviation fuel. The revised rates are effective from September 1, with the special excise duty on diesel exports increasing by ₹1 and a decrease of ₹0.50 for ATF exports.

item.title: Iran president Pezeshkian praises Putin’s support, says Russia and Tehran can resist US ‘unilateralism’
item.description: Pezeshkian made the remarks at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan, a day after the US and Iran exchanged attacks for the first time in weeks.

item.title: US Green Card: How 7% country cap could trap 1 million Indians in 179-year wait — is there a way out? Expert weighs in
item.description: Indian professionals may face a Green Card wait period of up to 179 years, especially in the EB-2 category, according to NFAP. Nearly one million Indian nationals are in the Green Card backlog, largely due to country-based caps limiting applicants from India to 7% of total allocations.&nbsp;

item.title: Commercial LPG prices hiked by ₹10 per cylinder; jet fuel prices up 5.6%
item.description: LPG supplies have been among the areas most affected by the West Asia war because India relied on West Asia for about 90% of its cooking gas imports before the conflict

item.title: ‘I was foolish to believe…’: Retired IAS officer Divya Mittal writes about serving rural India; social media reacts
item.description: Divya Mittal, an IAS officer who resigned after 13 years, expressed that her debt to India had grown. Her experiences, such as implementing a water project in Mirzapur, profoundly shaped her sense of duty and identity.

item.title: DGFT automates Free Sale and Commerce Certificate issuance to cut processing time for exporters
item.description: DGFT has automated Free Sale and Commerce Certificate issuance, reducing delays and compliance burdens for exporters. The system blends rule-based automation with risk-based manual oversight.

item.title: It’s the thought that counts! Chennai woman gave Ayodhya Ram Temple ₹4 crore cheque, had ₹3 in account
item.description: It is the thought that counts! Chennai woman gave Ayodhya Ram Temple ₹4 crore cheque. There was just ₹3 in her account

item.title: John Ternus takes over as Apple CEO: Net worth, marriage, career; why Apple choose him to succeed Tim Cook
item.description: John Ternus has worked on some of Apple’s prominent products, including the Apple Watch, AirPods, and Apple Vision Pro.

item.title: Anna Hazare health update: Activist ‘better and stable’, remains in hospital due to renal infection
item.description: Social activist Anna Hazare, 89, has been hospitalised in Mumbai due to a renal infection. His condition is stable, and doctors are assessing his health after initial treatment in Ralegan Siddhi. Hazare is known for his anti-corruption efforts and received the Padma Bhushan award.

item.title: Anthropic has already paid $1.5 billion: Why Sony Music and Warner Chappell still want more
item.description: Anthropic settled a $1.5 billion copyright case for pirated books. But, the Claude owner is now facing a new lawsuit from Sony and Warner over alleged music copyright violations.&nbsp;

item.title: Mamata Banerjee's niece, who lost job in alleged teacher-recruitment scam, found dead at home in Birbhum; details here
item.description: Bristy Mukherjee, niece of former CM of West Bengal and All India Trinamool Congress leader Mamata Banerjee, was reportedly found hanging at her residence in Birbhum, Rampurhat. She was 28.

item.title: Supreme Court scraps all FIRs for NEET protesters; CJP calls off September 5 march
item.description: The Supreme Court quashed FIRs against students involved in NEET paper leak protests, prompting CJP to call off its planned September 5 protest march.

item.title: Delhi Metro employee breaks Guinness record, travels across all stations in 14 hours, 54 minutes
item.description: Prafull Singh previously held the title in 2022, covering 254 stations in 16 hours, 2 minutes, and 17 seconds.

item.title: US-Iran war: Two oil supertankers targeted by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz, Marisks reports
item.description: Two oil supertankers, Sidr and Senegal Prosperity, were struck by unknown projectiles while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, maritime security consultant Marisks said. The incidents came amid renewed US-Iran hostilities, with UKMTO also reporting a tanker attack near Oman.

item.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian says Tehran will ‘immediately’ reciprocate if US returns to June MoU commitments
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Tehran would “immediately” reciprocate if the US returned to its June commitments aimed at ending the conflict. He also accused Washington and Israel of violating international law and warned against renewed regional tensions.

item.title: Why Zomato banned analogue paneer? What it is and how it harms even your healthy body | Explained
item.description: Zomato has introduced a zero-tolerance policy for analogue dairy products, asking restaurants to switch to natural dairy products or remove affected dishes. But what exactly is analogue paneer, and is it really unsafe?

item.title: India-Nepal rail link resumes: UP CM Yogi Adityanath flags off Varanasi-Nepalgunj trains
item.description: The launch marks the completion of the 56-kilometre Bahraich-Nanpara-Nepalgunj rail conversion from an outdated metre-gauge system to a broad-gauge network.
